indicator_name: CPI weights by COICOP division estimated from contributions to CPI growth, 2020-2026
description: Веса ИПЦ по разделам КООЛИЦ, оценка по вкладам в прирост ИПЦ, 2020-2026
methodology: Derived, not published: w = 100·Σc·(I−100)/Σ(I−100)² per year from CPI_CONTRIBUTION_YTD and CPI_DETAIL_YTD, food divisions rescaled to the published FOOD share and the rest to 100 − FOOD. Error against the official 2022 scheme 0.1-0.5 pp for most divisions (CP01 38.87 vs 38.75), up to ±2 pp for CP04/CP06/CP12. From 2026 COICOP 2018 (CP12_2018, CP13_2018).
